name: Manganese proteinate
description: Organic chemical compound that consists of manganese chelated with short-chain peptides.

name: Maize
description: Maize grain (Zea maysL.). Other name: corn (USA).

name: Disodium phosphate hydrate
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Na2HPO4·nH2O.

name: Cowpea seed
description: Seed of cowpea (Vigna unguiculata(L.) Walp.). Cowpea is a grain legume popular as human food in Africa and in some regions of Asia and the Americas. Other names: black-eyed pea, black-eyed bean, asparagus bean.

name: Sunflower seed, whole
description: Whole sunflower seed (Helianthus annuusL.). Other name: full fat sunflower seed.

name: Copra oil
description: Oil extracted from the dried kernels (copra) of the coconut fruit (Cocos nuciferaL.). Other name: coconut oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch < 20%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing less than 20% starch (as fed).

name: Copper citrate
description: Organic chemical compound with the formula Cu3(C6H5O7)2. Other name: copper(II) citrate.

name: Maize flour byproduct, protein 8-18%, oil 5-14%
description: Byproduct of flour or grits manufacture from maize grain (Zea maysL.), consisting of maize germs and other grain fragments.

name: Groundnut meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre > 9%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). The relatively high fibre content is due to the presence of skins and shells. It has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Soybean meal, oil < 5%, 50% protein + oil
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of soybean seeds (Glycine max(L.) Merr.), without reintroduction of the hulls. This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. It should contain about 50% (as fed) of protein + oil.

name: Wheat middlings, starch 30-40%
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain containing variable amounts of endosperm. Wheat middlings are often mixtures of different types of milling offal. They are typically richer in starch and less coarse than wheat bran, and poorer in starch and coarser than wheat feed flour. The composition and nutritive values are provided for wheat middlings containing between 30% and 40% of starch (as fed).

name: Cassava, starch 70-74%
description: Dried cassava roots (Manihot esculentaCrantz), containing 70-74% starch (as fed). Cassava roots are usually provided as chips, pellets or meal (ground chips).

name: Grass, dehydrated
description: Dehydrated grass from undetermined species.

name: Faba bean, coloured flowers, extruded
description: Extruded seed of faba bean (Vicia fabaL.) from high-tannin, coloured-flowered varieties. Other names: horse bean, field bean.

name: Maize germs
description: Dehydrated maize germs (Zea maysL.). Maize germs contain usually more than 30% oil (as fed). Other name: corn germs (USA).

name: Wheat bran from starch production
description: Byproduct of wheat starch production obtained by the wet milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivum L., also known as Triticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum). It consists principally of fragments of the outer skins and of particles of grain from which the greater part of the endosperm has been removed.

name: Mustard bran
description: Byproduct of mustard manufacture obtained from the processing of the seeds of mustard (Sinapis alba L.,Brassica juncea(L.) Czern.,Brassica nigraL.), consisting of seed hulls and other seed fractions.

name: Fodder beet, raw
description: Whole fresh root of beet (Beta vulgarisL.) of fodder varieties.

name: Potato pulp, dried
description: Dried byproduct of the processing (particularly starch manufacture) of potato tubers (Solanum tuberosumL.).
